newsitem.title: POLAND: SMALL POLISH SAVIM BANK TO FACE BANKRUPTCY- C.BANK.
newsitem.headline: SMALL POLISH SAVIM BANK TO FACE BANKRUPTCY- C.BANK.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland (NBP) suspended the activities of a small Warsaw bank, Savim Bank Depozytowo-Kredytowy SA, and filed for the bank's bankruptcy, the central bank said in a statement on Wednesday.
It said it suspended the bank and filed to the Warsaw provincial court a motion to declare the bank bankrupt saying it has lost the ability to meet its liabilities.
Savim officials were not immediately available for comment.
The Warsaw-based Savim bank last year did not make the top 50 of Polish banks in terms of shareholder capital and balance sheet total. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
